# `fnox plugin link`

- **Usage:** `fnox plugin link [-f --force] <NAME> <PATH>`

Link a local plugin directory for development

Installs NAME as a symlink to PATH, so edits take effect without reinstalling. `fnox plugin update` skips linked plugins.

## Arguments

- **`<NAME>`** — Plugin name
- **`<PATH>`** — Directory that contains `provider.lua`

## Flags

- **`-f --force`** — Replace an existing plugin of the same name
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Examples

**Link a checkout**

```sh
fnox plugin link corp ~/src/fnox-plugin-corp
```

**Replace an installed plugin**

```sh
fnox plugin link corp ./plugin --force
```
